parsed.title: PYROTECHNICS
parsed.body:
Discard a [fire].

OR

Place your [ICON: red marker with white grenade-shaped canister glyph] in your Room. When [intruder] enters
this Room, remove that [ICON: red marker with white grenade-shaped canister glyph]. Then, deal 2 Hits
and resolve a Shoot roll against this [intruder].
